title: The Daughters of Zelophehad Receive an Inheritance
description: Zelophehad from the tribe of Manasseh had no sons, only five daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah. They came forward before the priest Eleazar, Joshua and the leaders and reminded them that the Lord had commanded Moses to give them an inheritance among their brothers. They received an inheritance according to the Lord's command, and thus ten allotments fell to Manasseh in addition to Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan.
